descriptionChirho: The proper noun Elkanah (אֶלְקָנָה), meaning 'God has acquired/created', referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most prominently the father of Samuel (1 Sam 1-2) and various Levites in Chronicles. All 21 occurrences across languages render this consistently as a personal name: eng 'Elkanah/Elqanah', spa 'Elcaná/Elcana', hin 'एलकाना/एल्कानाह', arb 'أَلْقَانَة/أَلقانَة', kor '엘가나', swa 'Elkana'. The two clusters differ only in the presence of the conjunctive waw prefix (וְ), a grammatical particle that does not alter the referent or semantic content.
